normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents... “Hidden Gem #6”, your ideal retreat in Seacrest West! Located in the Arcadia Community, this two-story duplex is just 300 feet from Seabreeze Beach Access and steps from a sparkling pool. With 3 suites, a balcony with Gulf views, and modern amenities like Roku smart TV, it’s designed for your comfort. Use the 4 included bikes to explore 30A and enjoy nearby spots like The Big Chill, Alys Beach, and Rosemary Beach. Ready to plan your escape? Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Steps to Seabreeze Public Beach Access (300 Feet) - Feel the sand between your toes in just moments—your perfect beach day is only steps away.Inviting Community Pool Just Steps Away - Relax and rejuvenate in a serene pool setting, just a short stroll from your door.Peek-a-Boo Gulf Views from the Balcony - Enjoy a glimpse of the sparkling Gulf waters from your balcony—a little taste of paradise.4 Bikes Included with Rental for 30A Exploration - Cruise along 30A's scenic paths and charming neighborhoods with bikes ready for your adventures.High-Speed Internet & Roku Smart TVs for Streaming - Stay connected and entertained with fast Wi-Fi and endless streaming options for cozy nights in.Perfectly Located Between Rosemary Beach & The Hub - Experience the best of 30A with easy access to vibrant Rosemary Beach and the lively Hub.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Loved the peaceful location just steps from the beach and close to bike-friendly paths to Alys and Rosemary Beach. Great spot for shopping, dining, and a relaxing getaway!" – JT S.⭐ "First visit to 30A and it was perfect — peaceful area, easy beach access, and a short bike ride to Alys and Rosemary Beach for shopping and dining. Would definitely recommend!" – Maggie B.⭐ "One of the best locations we've had in 5 years on 30A — quiet beach right across the street!" – Tyler M.*** LIVING AREA ***Designed with relaxation in mind, the open-concept living area on the second floor welcomes guests with peek-a-boo Gulf views and plenty of natural light. Cozy up on the plush sofa and enjoy your favorite shows on the Smart Roku TV, or unwind with a good book in the charming seating nook while the coastal breeze wafts in from the balcony.Spacious open-concept design with glimpses of the sparkling Gulf watersComfortable sofa and plenty of seating for relaxationRoku Smart TV with access to Hulu and NetflixSeamless access to a private balcony overlooking the Gulf*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need, whether you're preparing a gourmet feast or a quick snack after a day at the beach. Featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and plenty of seating, it’s the perfect space to cook, dine, and create memories with loved ones.Modern kitchen fully equipped with stainless steel appliancesElegant granite countertops and a breakfast bar with seating for 3Spacious dining table accommodating up to 8 guestsOutdoor dining at the balcony for 4*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Primary King Suite: King bed, en-suite bathroom with dual vanity and tub/shower combo, and private porch access.Bunk Room: XL Twin-over-Queen bunk bed with private access to guest bathroom featuring tub/shower combo.2nd Floor:King Guest Suite: King bed with private access to shared hallway bathroom featuring walk-in shower and single vanity.*** OUTDOOR & COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Arcadia Community offers a warm and inviting atmosphere with something for everyone to enjoy. Head for a day to the beach across the road, cool off with a swim in the nearby community pool, or take advantage of the four provided bikes to explore the lively 30A community.Just steps away from the Seacrest Community PoolSeabreeze Public Beach Access (300 Feet across the road)Includes 4 bikes, perfect for exploring the scenic 30A area*** NEARBY ATTRACTIONS *** Nestled along the iconic Scenic Highway 30A, Hidden Gem strikes the perfect balance between easy accessibility and peaceful seclusion. Discover Seacrest’s unspoiled beaches, savor exquisite dining at Rosemary Beach, or immerse yourself in live music and vibrant events at The Big Chill, all just a short drive or bike ride away.The Big Chill – Located nearby (6-minute bike ride), this vibrant entertainment district is the perfect spot to unwind with live music, diverse restaurants, and unique shopping experiences.Alys Beach – Just a 4-minute drive away, this stunning seaside community offers a tranquil, luxurious vibe with its iconic white architecture and serene atmosphere.Rosemary Beach – A quick 5-minute drive takes you to this charming village known for its cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a lively yet relaxed vibe.Seaside – Only a 15-minute drive, this picturesque town exudes a classic, laid-back beach vibe with colorful cottages, outdoor markets, and scenic ocean views.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Parking available for 2 vehiclesThere is an active camera located at the top left corner facing the front door area.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSV (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 203974STRO #: STR-203974
